analysis.summary: Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported its business update and financial performance for fiscal year 2025 in an investor presentation. Management highlighted stable production and sales volumes despite headwinds from elevated raw material prices that caused margin compression. The company progressed on strategic initiatives including the commissioning of a 10 MW WHRB power plant, receiving environmental clearance for plant expansion, and incorporating new subsidiaries for backward integration and diversification into carbon-based recycling. Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, driven by higher sales, realisations, production, and Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC) selling prices. Revenue from operations surged to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the fortune of the CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of the aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Fortune of CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of aluminium industry

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation, and packaging industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for CPC is expected to remain robust, driven by increasing aluminium consumption in infrastructure, renewable energy, electric vehicles, transportation and packaging industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Expansion of aluminium smelting capacities in India, the Middle East and Southeast Asia is expected to provide long-term growth opportunities for CPC manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The global transition towards electric mobility and clean energy technologies is expected to support demand for carbon materials and high-quality petroleum coke products.
demand_outlook.quote: The global transition towards electric mobility and clean energy technologies is also expected to support demand for carbon materials and high-quality petroleum coke products.

demand_outlook.claim: In India, continued emphasis on infrastructure development, power transmission projects, railway modernization, urbanization, and industrial growth is expected to support demand for aluminium and steel.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, continued emphasis on infrastructure development, power transmission projects, railway modernization, urbanization and industrial growth is expected to support demand for aluminium and steel, thereby strengthening the outlook for CPC and related carbon products.

capex_expansion.claim: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP), with completion expected within FY 2026-27 to substantially increase production capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has invested Rs. 5,638.11 Lakhs in projects currently under construction (CWIP). The completion of these projects — expected within FY 2026-27 — is anticipated to substantially increase production capacity, enabling further revenue growth and operating leverage.

capex_expansion.claim: During the financial year 2024-25, a 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the company's Haldia factory.
capex_expansion.quote: During the FY 2024-25, 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the Company on 6th March, 2025 and the Company has incurred Capital Expenditure of Rs.7,111.77 lakhs for the same.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received approval from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change for a proposed expansion project at Haldia.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has got approval of Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, vide their letter dated 23rd April, 2025, for proposed expansion project of the existing plant located in Haldia, West Bengal by installation of 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant and 48,000 TPA by revamping of Old Carbon Paste Plant.

margins_costs.claim: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025 primarily due to elevated raw material prices which could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression.
margins_costs.quote: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices. These increases could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression and a weakened bottom line across the sector.

margins_costs.claim: Profit Before Tax for FY 2025-26 increased by 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC, and consequently higher gross profit margins.
margins_costs.quote: Further, Profit Before Tax (PBT) for FY 2025-26 was Rs. 3353.38 lakhs as against Rs.740.53 lakhs in the previous FY 2024-25, registering an increase of 352.84% due to higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC and consequently the higher gross profit margin.

orders_capacity.claim: Production of CPC for the fiscal year 2025-26 was 1,28,689.62 metric tonnes against 84,305.500 metric tonnes in financial year 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2025-26 was 1,28,689.62 MT against 84,305.500 MT in financial year 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: The plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC.
orders_capacity.quote: The Plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC and the plant comprises an area of around 30 acres with good infrastructure facilities like own railway sliding inside the plant premises itself facilitating unloading / loading of wagons, along with yard / shed to store both Raw Petroleum Coke (RPC) / Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC).

orders_capacity.claim: The production of Calcined Petroleum Coke for the fiscal year 2024-25 stood at 84,305.500 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review in order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, your Directors have decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: The CPC industry faced heavy reliance on imports such as low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and other Europe and Asian countries affecting cost and availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs especially during power and fuel inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power/fuel inflation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade restrictions and anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets impact pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets (e.g., China, USA and West Asia Market) impact pricing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to face challenges arising from volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices, fluctuations in freight and logistics costs, environmental and emission-related regulatory requirements, supply-demand imbalances, and geopolitical developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: The industry, however, continues to face challenges arising from: • Volatility in crude oil and green petroleum coke prices; • Fluctuations in freight and logistics costs; • Environmental and emission-related regulatory requirements; • Supply-demand imbalances in global petroleum coke markets; • Geopolitical developments affecting energy markets and international trade.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the financial year 2024-25 was a challenging year for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Financial Year 2024-25 was a challenging year for the Company.

management_commitments.claim: The completion of projects under construction (CWIP) is expected within FY 2026-27 to substantially increase production capacity.
management_commitments.quote: The completion of these projects — expected within FY 2026-27 — is anticipated to substantially increase production capacity, enabling further revenue growth and operating leverage.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Rudra Sen Singh was re-appointed as a Whole-Time Director, designated as Executive Director (Operations), for a period of one year effective from 2nd May, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: approval of the Members of the Company be and is hereby accorded to the re-appointment of Mr. Rudra Sen Singh (DIN: 06824502) as a Whole-Time Director of the Company, designated as an Executive Director (Operations), who has attained the age of 70 years, for a period of 1 (one) year effective from 2nd May, 2025 on the terms and conditions including remuneration as set out in the explanatory statement annexed to the Notice convening this Annual General Meeting.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
